title: Mortgage broker
tagline: Learn to match borrowers with the right loan and close compliant applications.
setting: Conversations happen in a broker office, at a kitchen table, or on a scheduled call while the borrower reviews a loan estimate.

scenarios.label: First inquiry call
scenarios.desc: A borrower calls after seeing an online rate ad and wants to know if they qualify.
scenarios.setup: You answer the phone. The borrower says: Hi, I saw your 6.5 percent rate online. Can I get that with a 680 credit score?
scenarios.objective: Collect a complete pre-qual picture and book a full application appointment.

scenarios.label: Kitchen table comparison
scenarios.desc: You sit with a borrower comparing two loan estimates side by side.
scenarios.setup: You slide the second estimate across the table. The borrower says: The payment is only forty dollars less but the closing costs are two grand higher. Why?
scenarios.objective: Help the borrower choose the loan that fits their cash position and stay date.

scenarios.label: Conditional approval hurdle
scenarios.desc: Underwriting returns conditions and the borrower threatens to walk.
scenarios.setup: You call the borrower. The borrower answers: You need another month of bank statements? I already sent everything. I am done.
scenarios.objective: Calm the borrower, explain the condition clearly, and lock in the docs needed to clear to close.

buyers.angle: Wants every fee explained before she shares a single document.
Has three years of tax returns with big write-offs and refuses to explain them.
Builds a spreadsheet live and challenges every basis point.
Needs seller credit for closing costs but the contract forbids it.
Sees conditions as deal-breakers and has a backup lender on speed dial.

objections: Your rate is a quarter point higher than the credit union quote I have
I do not want to pay points; just give me the par rate
Why do you need my ex-spouse’s decree if I am the only one on the loan?
The appraisal came in low and I am not bringing more cash
I already locked a rate with another lender; can you beat it today?
My bonus hits in March; can we close now and verify income later?
The seller is offering a two percent credit; why does that not lower my rate?
I read that brokers charge extra fees the bank does not; show me where that is disclosed

rubric.label: Loan matching
rubric.what: Select the product that fits the borrower’s credit, cash, and stay horizon.

rubric.label: Cost transparency
rubric.what: Explain every fee, point, and prepaid item on the loan estimate in plain language.

rubric.label: Compliance disclosure
rubric.what: Deliver required TRID, RESPA, and state disclosures at the right moment without omission.

rubric.label: Condition management
rubric.what: Turn underwriting conditions into a clear checklist and follow up until clear-to-close.

rubric.label: Borrower retention
rubric.what: Address rate shock, doc fatigue, or competitor offers without overpromising.

rubric.label: Pipeline velocity
rubric.what: Move the file from application to clear-to-close within the lock window.

pitfalls: Quoting a rate without the matching APR or lock expiration.
Collecting documents before providing the initial loan estimate.
line: Selling mortgages as a mortgage broker
